common.tagline: Instruments handcrafted, one at a time.

home.heroTitle: The instrument of your dreams, built by hand
home.heroSubtitle: At Bocatto you specify every detail of your instrument — model, woods, construction and finish — and the workshop prepares a tailored quote.
home.galleryIntro: Every piece below left our bench — designed, built and adjusted by hand, from the first cut to the final setup.
home.specialBody1: Not every instrument is born from a catalog. This special project — a guitar sculpted piece by piece — is taking shape right now on Bocatto's bench.
home.specialBody2: From the drawing to the raw wood, every special project is an invitation to go beyond tradition. If you imagine an instrument that doesn't exist yet, this is exactly how it begins.
home.specialAlt: Special-project guitar under construction at the Bocatto workshop
home.pillar1Body: Tops, backs and sides chosen piece by piece, naturally seasoned for years, for a voice that matures with you.
home.pillar2Body: No assembly line. Every joint, purfling and finish is executed by hand, one instrument at a time.
home.pillar3Body: An instrument designed around your touch: tension, scale and voicing tailored to the way you play.
home.priceBody: Each project is quoted individually, according to the model, woods and details you choose.
home.ctaBody: Specify your instrument like a custom-order spec sheet. At the end, the workshop receives a complete document to prepare your quote — no commitment.

about.title: About Bocatto
about.historyTitle: A life devoted to wood and sound
about.historyBody1: Bocatto Luthieria was born from a passion for turning wood into music. In our luthiery workshop every instrument is built from scratch, by hand, following traditional techniques refined over years of craft.
about.historyBody2: We don't do serial production. Each instrument is a unique project, designed in conversation with the person who will play it — from the soundboard woods to the rosette design.
about.philosophyBody: We believe a great instrument is born from the balance between tradition and personality. That's why we listen before we build: your repertoire, your touch and your references guide every design decision.
about.catalogIntro: Six bodies, each with its own voice. All designed in the workshop and built to order, wood by wood.
